title: Answer: two kinds of information meet in one neuron

statements.text: The theory gives no formal definition of information. It distinguishes two categorically distinct kinds that meet in a layer 5 neuron: externally grounded information processed by the basal compartment and internally generated information processed by the apical compartment.

sources.quote: the basal compartment (red) processes externally-grounded information whereas the apical compartment (orange) processes internally-generated information
